intro: Yelmak's Medley is an Orgrimmar quest centered on easing tensions inside Yelmak's Alchemy and Potions in the Valley of Honor. Master alchemist Yelmak seeks to curb the destructive clumsiness and stubborn pride of his apprentice Whuut by preparing a soothing home-brewed mixture made from local water plants.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Yelmak doesn't want his apprentice breaking anything. Well, anything more than he already has.
He told me the young mixer in training has too much pride to ask for help when he really needs it. Yelmak wants to give him a taste of a particular home-brewed recipe.

Gather a mix of cattail and speargrass cuttings taken from the plants growing around the water in the Valley of Honor. I'd get them myself, but if I left the shop, Whuut would surely know we're catering to his mood.

clips.title: Progress
paras: We discover formulations and recipes by showing old ingredients to new generations, who experiment with them in their own way.

clips.title: Completion
paras: This type of cattail and speargrass is unique to Orgrimmar. Drinking from Azshara mountain spring water, and nourished by the sweat and blood soaked mineral dust of our rocky land, these herbs contain potent powers locked within.
I'll give these to Yelmak, who may be able to win back Whuut's ear with a hands-on lesson.
